title: Clean configuration for a guessed run
statement: Let $P$ and $Q$ be deterministic machines with state sets $SP$ and $SR$, respectively, over Boolean work tapes, and let $z$ be a finite Boolean input. Suppose $\iota$ embeds the $K$ tape indices into the $k$ tape indices, the tape index $cap$ lies outside the image of $\iota$, and $jR<K$. Let $blk$ be a tape content that is blank at every integer position $p<0$ or $p\ge m$, and let $s$ be a Boolean word of length $m$. For every state $q$ of $P$ and entry state $entry$ of $Q$, applying the guessed-run configuration construction to the configuration with state $q$, input-head position $1$, all tape contents blank except for content $blk$ on tape $\iota(jR)$, all work-tape heads at zero, and empty output, yields exactly the embedded silent configuration of the stream-start configuration for $Q$ with state $entry$, tape $jR$ containing $s$, and all other tapes blank.
hypotheses_covered: An embedding $\iota$ from $K$ tape indices into $k$ tape indices
A tape index $cap$ outside the image of $\iota$
A natural number $m$ such that $blk(p)$ is blank for $p<0$ or $p\ge m$
